purpose: Does real rat/human decision knowledge improve a causally sensed acting agent beyond equal-observation expert/sham priors and a fresh matched cold learner? Conventional BC/PPO feasibility, not a new algorithm or identified biological plasticity mechanism.

data.sampling: Seed641293, sorted original (subject,configuration,trial,move) inventory; uniform without replacement of moving transitions, no outcome filtering; retain identities, source population and sampling counts.
data.sensor_reconstruction: Synthetic source-cache views at observed current cell. Initial camera faces room centre; later camera heading is PREVIOUS observed moving direction, never the current target direction. Native retinal/gaze/contact/time data are unavailable. Raw contact and previous reward reconstructed as zero because examples are within moving traces; disclose assumptions. Own last action from previous recorded moving transition.
data.belief: Same frozen400-view open-arena atlas, uniform100-cell start and causal past-motion/current-cue replay. No true coordinates, future cell, goal bearing, current action or native success flag enters policy input. Known layout used only by renderer and expert labeler.
data.expert: Optimal one-step moving labels at EXACT same sampled observations as each species; shortest-path goal and geometry are privileged offline expert supervision, never runtime policy inputs.
data.sham: Permute action labels among the selected moves within subject/configuration; identical observations/marginal actions/BC budget.
data.budget: 6000 unique real moving choices/species, three synthetic texture reconstructions/choice,20 epochs =360000 labeled presentations/BC arm; report alongside charged RL frames. Native measured sensory frames are not available.

network: Same FF64x64 tanh252-to4 actor/shared value head,20677 parameters; new GPU wrapper retains parent CPU output/collection/update interface and reviewed PPO loss.

bc.objective: Cross-entropy on actor logits, no terminal reward/critic target
bc.critic_weights: Never updated by BC; shared features may change.
bc.cold: No offline pretraining; separate cost category and matched RL interactions.

rl.source_train: Openarena0 +source1–5, unchanged registered curriculum32768/65536 boundaries and final native starts; no native choices from6–7.
rl.settings: Unchanged reviewed long-control PPO:128 decisions,4 epochs,2 minibatches,GAE/gamma/clip/entropy/value from source parent.

selection.rule: Fixed BC/PPO hyperparameters; no learning-rate selection. Report all7arms/all3paired fresh seeds,180 trials per arm. Development feasibility only:6–7 have been examined in earlier work. No untouchedtest claim.
selection.primary: Per-seed differences in adaptive success for rat_bc vs rat_sham/rat_expert/cold and human_bc vs human_sham/human_expert/cold; frozen-arm results and observed decision costs secondary.
selection.go_for_confirmatory_test: Only after source cohort complete and independent audit; biologically derived prior must improve useful action generalization beyond matched sham/cold without claiming biological specificity if expert matches or wins. Lock separate8–25/retention protocol afterward, not part of this pilot.

resources.device: GPU0, RTX4090, desktop headroom >=3GiB; no GUI/Unity

failure_policy: Preserve complete/partial/numerical failures and exact counts; implementation/IO invalidates cohort, no retry/seed replacement. All21 terminal plus independent data/physics/checkpoint/choice/replay audit before interpretation.
boundary: No native/digital8–25, no real neural mechanism, no single-cell equivalence, no no-forgetting/energy claim. Behavioral resemblance alone is not knowledge-transfer utility.
